notes.decision: The chapter number ⲣⲓⲃ (112) appears at start AND end of the chapter title line, a decorative scribal convention emphasizing the chapter number. Preserved as transcribed.

Translated 'lesser compared to / humble compared to' preserving ⲡⲁⲣⲁ + comparative semantics. ⲥⲁⲃⲕ is the qualitative of ⲥⲟⲃⲕ̄ 'be small/diminished' (already in glossary as ⲥⲃⲁⲕ); ϩⲃⲁⲃⲉ qualitative of ϩⲃⲃⲓⲟ 'humble.'

Lycopolitan temporal conjunctive: ⲛ̄ⲧⲁⲣⲉϩ- = 'after he-' (with Lyc ϩ for ϥ); ⲃⲁⲃⲩ contains 3pl object suffix on ϩⲃⲃⲓⲟ-stem. Translated 'when he had brought them low' — the floodwaters being lowered. The directional ⲁⲃⲁⲗ ('forth') reinforces the abating sense.

ⲉⲧϣⲁⲭⲍ̄ qualitative possibly from ϣⲱⲕϩ̄ 'be deep'; with ⲡϩⲛⲟⲩⲛ 'the Deep' (in glossary) it functions as the bottomless/unfathomable Deep — the archetypal cosmic depth being likened to the river's depth.

ⲡⲓ-†ⲟⲩ = 'this five' (collective demonstrative + numeral). Translated 'all this five-fold whole cosmos.' Manichaean cosmology recognizes a five-worlds structure (cf. ⲡⲉϩⲧⲟⲩ ⲛ̄ⲕⲟⲥⲙⲟⲥ 'the five worlds' in accumulated vocabulary); here applied to flesh-worlds.

ⲡⲥⲟⲍⲉ uncertain — appears to function as a dimension-noun paired with ⲭⲓⲥⲉ 'height' in the four-fold dimensional series. Tentatively translated 'stature,' possibly related to ⲥⲱϩⲉ 'stand/erection' giving 'standing-up, stature.' Could alternatively be 'extent' or 'summit.' The four-fold sequence is height/breadth/length/depth — ⲥⲟⲍⲉ functions as the height-correspondent of the mountain.

ⲡⲓⲧⲁⲩ functions plurally here (collective demonstrative referring to 'these mountains'); ⲛ̄ⲟⲩⲉ 'of one' = 'of one of them.' Translated 'one of these mountains.' Confirmed by line 23 ⲡⲟⲩⲉ ⲡⲟⲩⲉ ⲛ̄ⲧⲁⲩ ⲧⲏⲣⲟⲩ 'each one of all of them.'

ⲡϣⲓⲏⲛⲥ tentatively translated 'length' as the third dimension in the four-fold series after height/breadth, before ϣⲓⲭⲍϥ̄ 'depth.' From ϣⲓⲏ 'length, dimension' + possessive marker. The four dimensions together (height/breadth/length/depth) constitute the standard cosmic-spatial inventory.
ⲡϣⲓⲭⲍϥ̄ = 'depth/abyss' (cf. ⲡϣⲓⲭϩ 'abyss/pit' in accumulated vocabulary). The fourth and final dimension. Same lexeme appears in possessed forms ⲧⲉϩϣⲓⲭⲍϩ (var. spelling) and ⲡⲉϩϣⲓⲭⲍϩ.
ⲱⲙⲕ̄ 'swallow up, be sunken' (cf. accumulated ⲁⲱⲙⲥ̄ 'submerge'). Conjunctive 3pl future-of-purpose: 'that they may be swallowed up' — describing humans relative to the cosmic sea.

ⲡⲕⲁⲣⲁⲓ̈ⲧ 'the silent (one)' (cf. ⲡⲕⲁⲣⲁⲓ̈ⲧϩ 'the Stillness' in accumulated vocabulary, here without final ϩ); ⲛ̄ⲥⲉⲍⲟⲩ conjunctive 3pl + ⲥⲁⲍⲟⲩ (Lyc ⲥⲁϩⲟⲩ) 'curse.' The damaged context prevents identifying the curser/cursed; preserved literally.
